verdict_text: C — non-closing, by the pre-declared table applied literally: the 3 GHz excess now holds ONE sign (negative, sv_max below unity) at all three rungs, but |e1|/|e2| = 0.586 and |e2|/|e4| = 0.959 are both < 2, so outcome A fails, and the spread 8.608e-4 exceeds 0.20*|e1| = 2.208e-4, so outcome B fails. What CHANGED versus the pre-#897 ladder (also C, by a sign flip): the over-unity excess is gone — every bin at every rung is now strictly below unity (unity_crossing_hz empty at all three rungs) — and the residual is a NEGATIVE deficit that CONVERGES with dx (-1.104e-3 -> -1.884e-3 -> -1.965e-3, |e2|/|e4| = 0.959) rather than halving. A converging below-unity deficit is a loss floor, not a dt/2 artefact; the part that WAS a dt/2 artefact is exactly what #897 removed (per-rung max|Delta S| halves, ratios 1.880 / 1.880; Delta e(3 GHz) / theta(3 GHz) = -0.482 / -0.491 / -0.498 -> -1/2). No gate is touched: _THRU_MAX_SINGULAR_VALUE stays 1.01 and _THRU_PASSIVITY_PHYSICAL_BOUND stays 1.0.
outcome_table_scope_note: The outcome table of section 3 was written for an over-unity excess and has no cell for 'the excess is gone and the remainder converges'. It is applied here exactly as written and NOT re-aimed; the observation that its A/B/C partition no longer matches the quantity being measured is recorded for the PI, not acted on.
